methods.description: Authenticate issue body/pins from Git blobs; require 21 unique candidate IDs, the exact 10 contact subject IDs, complete 109/161 full products, and compute consumed and same-release full-polygon pair intersections separately.
methods.software: Python 3.12.14; Shapely 2.1.2; GEOS 3.13.x; Git pinned blobs.
methods.units: Planar intersection area in square degrees; pair counts; exact feature identity.
methods.crs: Input GeoJSON CRS84 longitude/latitude coordinates as stored; no transformation.
methods.area_method: Shapely planar geometry intersection area in source coordinate space; not ground area.

pairs with unequal planar intersection area

pairs with unequal planar intersection area

conclusions.text: The pinned legacy full-product command accepts same-length duplicate inventory rows and therefore does not authenticate complete candidate/contact membership itself.

The historical pair loop uses the consumed contact geometries; replacing them with same-release full geometries changes 35 of 210 measured planar intersection areas. This does not establish territorial or boundary truth.
Current boundary authority, legal meaning, parent relationships, source completeness and physical-component assignment remain unresolved.
